items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: When we got down there, David... Not Goliath, but David. David had been on DeParis' show, then he told us, 'Man, let's leave here...' ... Then we had another act on the show called Shorty and David. David and Goliath -- Shorty.

ctx.x: Before you get into that, could you tell just a little bit about the minstrel show? You've already mentioned the carnival...

Well, I'm still on the minstrel show. When we got down there, David... Not Goliath, but David. David had been on DeParis' show, then he told us, "Man, let's leave here..." -- because we wasn't gettin' no money with Mr. Young. He wasn't givin' us nothin' much, you know what I mean? Business got bad. He'd give us maybe 50 cents or a dollar, something like that...
